Good to know

The honest fine print.

Check-in & check-out

Check-in from 3 PM. Check-out (and your parking spot) by 10 AM. Confirmed reservations are held until 6 PM unless you let us know.

Reserving your week

A two-day deposit confirms your reservation, credited to the first and last days of your stay. Deposits are refundable, less 25%, with three weeks' notice.

House rules

The whole property is smoke-free. Children 3 and under stay free. One car per unit, and no pets or bicycles in the rooms.
